synth.notes:
Single mirror axis (wall row) + 3x3-block pieces; A1-A4 move selection one block (axis rows only, pieces blocked by bounds/overlap); A5 cycles axis -> pieces largest-first -> axis.
Every piece block reflects to row 2*axis-r (clipped); layers wall<target<reflection<piece composited per block, holes show first solid below else top fill; re-extracted as 4-connected comps (walls/pieces ranked with all 0 cells).
Missed mechanic at step 64: budget counter has 64 free actions then shrinks 1/action (h=min(64,128-n)); once spent, the HUD adds a phantom player comp ranked first, so piece_i -> piece_{i+1}.
A7 undoes the last position change and costs no budget; n and undo history are hidden state gated on continuity (stateless fallback n=128-h if h<64 else 0).
Stateless the program gets 102/104 (fails only step 64 reserve and step 70 undo); the reflection mixed-outcome hypothesis is pieces/reflections merging into one component, not hidden state.
